children: On Sept 15, BTCUSD spot saw ETF products net outflows while Binance logged large Bitcoin inflows, highlighting a divergence between ETF and spot exchange flows for traders.
An on-chain address opened a new 2,450 BTC long in BTCUSD spot CFD (~$190M), quoted order size $78,000, activity tracked on-chain and reported just now.
BTCUSD net realized P/L dropped to $31.8M on Sept 16, 2026, an 89% weekly fall; coins moved to exchanges during the week weren’t sold at profits.
BTCUSD slid to a near four‑week low after the Senate rejected the Clarity Act, raising regulatory uncertainty as federal agencies may take a bigger role in crypto oversight.
BTCUSD traders: coin-margined futures open interest dropped to ~12% by mid-2026 from ~70% in early 2021; major perpetual venues shifted to stablecoin/USD margining. (CME futures excluded)
OFAC sanctioned Iranian exchange BitBank, citing hundreds of millions in BTC transfers to IRGC-linked parties in June–July, affecting regulatory risk for BTCUSD spot trading and custody.
Reduced use of coin-margined collateral removed a feedback loop that amplified BTCUSD downside: BTC-margined positions previously saw rapid collateral erosion and triggered liquidation cascades.
BTCUSD: Bull Score fell 80→30 after rate hike; short-term holder sentiment weakened; ETF flows flipped to outflows; renewed downward price pressure noted.
BTCUSD spot CFD: short-term HODL supply (1–7d) rose from 1.97% on July 1 to 2.35% on July 5. Short-term holders stayed partially profitable for 30 straight days in 2026.
Kevin O'Leary is buying digital assets and projects BTCUSD spot to reach about $150,000 near term; he also outlined a longer-term bull case tied to institutional adoption.
